status: Identification analysis grounded in actual configuration; no novel loss or performance theorem
current_candidate: A furniture policy predicts D from current public multimodal state X, then emits executable A conditioned on its own D. All other required stages and tool models are common across arms.

controls.name: equal_material_direct
controls.training: Same original D and A labels, source weights and missing-D units; D(X) auxiliary task and A(X) direct action
controls.identifies: Whether conditioning execution on the predicted decision adds value beyond the same supervision

controls.name: base_plus_search
controls.deployment: Ordinary multi-operation search with the same legal assets, actions, observations and cumulative budget
controls.identifies: Whether learned decision selection improves on ordinary computation

controls.name: paired_decision_action
controls.training: D(X), A(X,D) where original D exists; missing-D treatment must be declared and shared data retained
controls.deployment: D_hat sampled from actual X, then A(X,D_hat), native tool feedback updates X
controls.identifies: End-to-end self-conditioned policy under actual accumulated errors

full_task_success.event: S = conjunction of original mandatory scene requirements at final exported state
full_task_success.stage_factorization: For actual stage-success events E_1,...,E_K, P(all E_k)=product_k P(E_k | E_1,...,E_{k-1}); independence is not assumed.
full_task_success.limit: All-stage-finalizer return is a control-flow event, not E_k. A missing required object stage cannot be counted as success merely because the executable loop ends.
full_task_success.current_contradiction: The composed config contains manipuland_agent, but the inspected driver executes only floor_plan/furniture/wall/ceiling and floor-only furniture generation. Required surface-object tasks are not qualified.

teacher_to_self_conditioning.fixed_action_policy_assumption: For a fixed public state x and fixed downstream policy/tool environment, let v_x(d) be the probability of task success, in [0,1].
teacher_to_self_conditioning.bound: |E_q[v_x(D)] - E_p[v_x(D)]| <= TV(q,p). Here q is a reference decision distribution and p is the deployed predicted distribution.
teacher_to_self_conditioning.meaning: Teacher-conditioned action accuracy does not establish deployed scene success when predicted decisions differ. This is the ordinary total-variation expectation bound, not a new theorem.
teacher_to_self_conditioning.evidence_limit: Current single source annotations do not identify q or TV. No numeric guarantee or claimed improvement follows; measure actual self-generated trajectories instead.

cost_identification.confound_observed: Local policy + local VLM binding does not cover eager image backend construction and generated-image/texture paths. Different fallback settings alter asset availability and cannot be treated as a decision-only ablation.
cost_identification.resolution: Fix the common runnable service and task contract first. Do not let one arm use paid image models or remove surface-object requirements to obtain apparent parity.

result_required: Independent description families; actual complete scenes, original requirement denominators, preserved relations, unknown coverage, and quality versus all-in budget. No claim from number of audits or token-format compliance.
current_evidence: No additional full-scene generation or learned benefit in this turn.
next_source_work: Trace and reuse upstream manipuland execution and asset acquisition in the common runtime. Do not invent a scene-specific fill tool or train a replacement generator.
